findings.claim_text: Frontier-Bench v0.1 scores peak at xhigh (44.4%) and dip to 43.3% at the top level, max, independently reproduced by Artificial Analysis's own Coding Agent Index.

Once fallback is configured on the raw API, a fallback-served turn is machine-detectable: the top-level model field always names the actual responder and usage.iterations records the handoff explicitly.

Anthropic's Fable 5 model card (June 9, 2026) explicitly stated that safeguards on frontier-LLM-development requests will not be visible to the user and that Fable 5 will not fall back to a different model, reversed within roughly a day after backlash.
